mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 5 Series M550d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW M550d engine replacement is a significant investment due to the complex tri-turbo or quad-turbo setup. For the N57D30C (F10/F11, 2012-2016), rebuilt units range from £5,500-£8,000. For the B57D30S0 (G30/G31, 2017-2023), expect £6,000-£8,500. Labour for supply and fit adds approximately £1,300-£2,000 (20-30 hours at independent specialist rates) due to the engine's complexity.

mainEntity.name: Does the BMW M550d have timing chain problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - but it depends on the generation. The N57S engine (F10/F11, 2012-2016) suffers from the same rear-positioned timing chain issues as the N47, with chain stretch and tensioner failure possible between 80,000-120,000 miles. The B57S engine (G30/G31, 2017-2023) is significantly more robust, with timing chain stretch and guide failures being exceedingly rare.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW M550d?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the generation and the car's value. A typical F10/F11 M550d (2012-2016) is worth £12,000-£25,000, making a £5,500-£8,000 replacement a significant but often viable investment for well-maintained examples. A G30/G31 M550d (2017-2023) is worth £25,000-£45,000, making a £6,000-£8,500 replacement easily justified. For cars at the lower end of the value spectrum, evaluate carefully.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the N57S and B57S engines in the M550d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The N57S (F10/F11, 2012-2016) is a 3.0-litre tri-turbo straight-six diesel producing 381hp and 740Nm. The B57S (G30/G31, 2017-2023) is a 3.0-litre quad-turbo straight-six diesel producing 400hp and 760Nm. The B57S is significantly more reliable, with far fewer timing chain issues, though both engines share turbocharger complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW M550d engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW M550d engine replacement takes 4-7 working days for supply and fit through an independent specialist. The complex tri-turbo or quad-turbo setup requires significantly more labour than a standard diesel engine. Allow additional time for parts sourcing and any ancillary work.

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a BMW M550d replacement engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every rebuilt and reconditioned BMW M550d engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Terms vary by supplier - some offer extended coverage up to 24 months on premium rebuilds. Used engines typically come with a shorter warranty (30-90 days) depending on the supplier and mileage.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 5 Series M550d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW M550d uses two very different engines depending on generation - the N57S tri-turbo (F10/F11) and the B57S quad-turbo (G30/G31). The N57S is more prone to timing chain and turbocharger issues, while the B57S is significantly more reliable but still has its weak points. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Failure - Why the N57S M550d Is at Risk
problems.rootCause: The N57 engine suffers from the same rear-positioned timing chain issues as the N47. The timing chain tensioner can fail, leading to chain stretch and, if ignored, catastrophic engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace chain, tensioner and guides - engine-out job
repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early with rattle symptoms
Best if chain has failed causing valve/piston damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical used BMW M550d (F10/F11, 2012-2016) sits in the £12,000-£25,000 bracket. For a car worth under £15,000, a full engine replacement may represent 30-50% of the vehicle's value - evaluate carefully. For well-maintained, low-mileage examples worth £20,000+, replacement is usually justified.
problems.recommendation: If you hear a cold-start rattle from your N57S M550d, get the timing chain inspected immediately. A £1,200-£2,200 chain replacement is far cheaper than a £5,500+ full engine replacement if the chain fails catastrophically.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N57D30C BMW 5 Series M550d engine prices

problems.h4: Turbocharger Failure - Tri-Turbo and Quad-Turbo Complexity
problems.rootCause: The N57S uses three BorgWarner turbochargers - a small unit for low RPM, a larger for mid-range, and a second small for high RPM. The B57S uses four turbochargers. This complexity means more components that can fail, often due to oil starvation or excessive wear.

repairOptions.longevity: If only one turbo has failed

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace all turbos, oil lines, actuators

repairOptions.longevity: Only if turbo failure has caused other damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Turbocharger repairs are a manageable percentage of most M550d values. For a car worth £15,000+, a £800-£1,800 repair is a sensible investment.
problems.recommendation: Don't ignore loss of power, excessive smoke, or whining noises from the engine bay. A £800-£1,800 turbo repair is far cheaper than a £5,500+ full engine replacement if the issue is left to escalate.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 5 Series M550d engine repair costs

problems.group: Fuel Injector and Swirl Flap Issues
problems.h4: Fuel Injector and Swirl Flap Issues - Diesel-Specific Problems
problems.rootCause: Faulty fuel injectors can cause rough idling and increased emissions. Swirl flap actuator failure is also reported, leading to loss of power and check engine lights.

repairOptions.longevity: If swirl flap error is persistent

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Injector and swirl flap repairs are a small fraction of any M550d's value and should be addressed promptly.
problems.recommendation: If you experience rough idling or a check engine light, get a diagnostic scan. A £300-£600 swirl flap repair or £800-£1,500 injector replacement is far cheaper than the consequences of ignoring the issue.
